# The Examined Classroom

Official site: https://examinedclassroom.com/

The Examined Classroom is the personal website of Matthew A. Zinn, a philosopher and educator working across moral psychology, AI ethics, philosophy of education, and educational technology.

The site publishes classroom-ready thought experiments, educator resources, research-backed AI ethics guidance, and practical AI tools for K-12 teachers, school leaders, students, and families.

## Priority Pages

- About: https://examinedclassroom.com/about
- Interactive Thought Experiments: https://examinedclassroom.com/thought-experiments
- Interactive Tools: https://examinedclassroom.com/tools
- AI in Education: https://examinedclassroom.com/ai-education
- AI Ethics in Education: https://examinedclassroom.com/ai-ethics
- Research Resources: https://examinedclassroom.com/resources
- For Educators: https://examinedclassroom.com/for-educators
- Credits and AI disclosures: https://examinedclassroom.com/credits
- Terms of Use: https://examinedclassroom.com/terms

## Key Topics

- AI ethics in education
- K-12 classroom thought experiments
- Philosophy for children and adolescents
- Moral psychology and AI alignment
- School AI policy and responsible AI use
- Academic integrity, feedback, engagement, and leadership
